narrative.details:
These wastelands are riddled with redstone basilisk, adventurer. These basilisk have adapted and flourished, more so than any of the other wildlife within the region.

I have watched from afar as they hunt and go about their daily activities - the beasts exhibit a thought process more complex than even some humanoids.

I must study their brains!

Retrieve ten of their brains for me, adventurer. The compound cannot be complete, however, without two vulture gizzards to form the base of the solution.
narrative.objectives: Bring ten Basilisk Brains and two Vulture Gizzards to Bloodmage Lynnore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
This is wondrous, adventurer! My offering to you is a taste of the inner workings of the redstone basilisk.

Should the compound be to your liking, more can always be made... for a price.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you returned with the requested organs?
